## Manual Import

Single Responsibility: a lightweight webhook for a single quick-add entry, e.g. from an iOS/Android Shortcut, a bookmarklet, or curl. Distinct from 01 - Intake / Manual - CSV Bulk Import, which handles batch backfills — this is for one transaction at a time. Also distinct from the app's own manual transaction form in the UI, which doesn't need n8n at all; this exists for automation clients outside the browser.

Accepts EITHER free text (routed through the same heuristic parser as SMS/Telegram) OR pre-structured fields (skips parsing entirely — see Parse Transaction's own note).

Expected POST body — either:
  { rawText: string }
or:
  { amount: string, description: string, date?: ISOString, type?: string, currency?: string }

Webhook URL (after import, self-hosted): <your-n8n-instance>/webhook/budgetflow/manual-import

nodes.name: Parse Transaction
nodes.notes: After importing, point this at the "02 - Processing / Parse Transaction" workflow (n8n assigns IDs on import). This one call cascades through the whole pipeline (Validate → Duplicate Check → Categorize → Create Transaction → BudgetFlow handles all downstream business logic).
